rows.reason: The player-seat path lacks the gun-class Function view and operative 0072D5B0 mode-selection consumer; its current mention records the unbound request.
Retiring native ReconEntry payloads needs their full 1Ch member-list and observer ownership; chain543 owns host unit/level payloads and only reuses native list nodes.
The group fold lacks native member ReconEntry lists and each squadron unit's per-side detection record, detector observer and change delegate.
The host's repair-area registry is empty; an actual repair-zone area producer and its party/containment records are missing.
The adapter returns zero and has no owned native command-target object or downstream command-event consumer to receive the initialized target.
This is an alphabetical reflection snapshot, whose 00AAAED0 descriptor-walk caller is missing here; it cannot replace the bridge's authored-Z draw order.
No received immediate-angle snapshot producer/consumer supplies the four target/current values at this seam; existing aim commands use the distinct 0085ABA0 path.
The host shares device hierarchy descriptors but lacks per-instance barrelfrontN node matrices, recoil records and their shot-driven producer; a zero-barrel update would omit real recoil.
The base update also needs the actual gun meshholder/wreck-visibility state and per-barrel recoil lifetime, which the shared descriptor-only model does not provide.
